label: NOTE: what this set covers, and what it cannot
why: V90SpectralShaper.cpp entire: the constructor and the destructor, which are the only two of the class's eight members reconstructed.  What cannot be mutated into a caught failure is the SYNTAX of the +0x38 store: moving it from the member-initialiser list into the body changes the instruction order and nothing an observer can see, because the encoder's constructor does not read +0x38.  That is a codegen claim (finding 1243) and it is checked by the similarity tier, not here.  The two buffers' element type is likewise not mutable -- `unsigned short *` against `short *` allocates the same 48 bytes and this file never dereferences either.
